entry.title: New: Bill 54 (2024) (Maui) — Agenda Ready
entry.content:
"A BILL FOR AN ORDINANCE AMENDING THE FISCAL YEAR 2024 BUDGET FOR THE COUNTY OF MAUI, REVENUES AND DEPARTMENT OF FINANCE, COUNTYWIDE COSTS, INSURANCE PROGRAMS AND SELF INSURANCE, MAUI WILDFIRES COMPENSATION PROGRAM" The purpose of this bill is to 1) increase Carryover/Savings in the General Fund and Total Estimated Revenues by $10,000,000; and 2) amend Department of Finance, Countywide Costs by increasing the appropriation for Insurance Programs and Self Insurance, Category B in the amount of $10,000,000 and increase the Total Operating Appropriations and Total Appropriations by the same amount.
